notes.id: Uang pangkal = infaq pendidikan Rp1.000.000 + infaq pengembangan pilihan Rp4.250.000 / Rp4.750.000 / Rp5.250.000. Diskon 20% infaq pengembangan untuk lulusan TKIT Mutiara Insani. Kuota 2 rombel × 28 siswa.
notes.en: Entry fee = education donation Rp1,000,000 + development donation option Rp4,250,000 / Rp4,750,000 / Rp5,250,000. 20% development-donation discount for TKIT Mutiara Insani graduates. Quota 2 classes × 28.
